reviewer_response_text: We tested 29,042 unique public DNA elements as exact 2-, 4-, 8-, 16- and 32-copy arrays. 3,095 elements admitted complete in-silico HURDLER routes from a purchasable seed at all five lengths. Across 145,210 exact targets, 145,205 had classifiable API evidence; among those, 15,530 completed the full route with a sequence-identical final product.
